subject: Money
title: Central Bank Digital Currencies
description: A short lesson to help you apply Central Bank Digital Currencies.

hook.text: China's digital yuan lets the government track every transaction in real time. 260 million wallets by 2023.

buildup.text: CBDCs are digital cash issued by central banks. Over 130 countries are exploring them.

discovery.text: They combine digital convenience with government control. Programmable money that can expire or restrict.

twist.text: Privacy advocates are alarmed. A government that controls digital money can freeze anyone's wallet.

climax.text: CBDCs could end financial crime or enable total surveillance. The same tool, opposite futures.

punchline.text: Digital cash. Total visibility. Your call.
